compiled_state.title: UPDATE: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md + REVIEW-WORKFLOW-HUGE.md — remove cycle-count tier ratchets; add oscillation short-circuit ESCALATE_REVIEW
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What
Update REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md and REVIEW-WORKFLOW-HUGE.md to decouple tier upgrades from cycle-count, per story 153c-922c.

## Changes to REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md

### Remove PASS_NUM>=2 ratchet
Find and remove the block: `if [ "${REVIEW_PASS_NUM}" -ge 2 ]` ... light->standard tier ratchet logic. Tier stays at initial value unless an explicit ESCALATE_REVIEW signal fires.

### Remove MAX_ATTEMPTS->deep upgrade  
Find and remove the post-loop block: 'MAX_ATTEMPTS exceeded' -> upgrade to deep tier. Replace with: emit ESCALATE_REVIEW: oscillation_no_arbiter_engagement (see below).

### Add short-circuit oscillation detection
Add new logic block:
- Track per-file-region NEW_INTRODUCED count across consecutive cycles
- If 2 consecutive cycles show NEW_INTRODUCED for the same file+region without escape_rationale → emit ESCALATE_REVIEW: oscillation_no_arbiter_engagement
- If MAX_ATTEMPTS exhausted without any arbiter dispatch having occurred → emit ESCALATE_REVIEW: oscillation_no_arbiter_engagement

## Changes to REVIEW-WORKFLOW-HUGE.md
Scan for FALLBACK tier ratchet patterns (same PASS_NUM or MAX_ATTEMPTS logic). Either:
- Remove if present (same treatment as main workflow)
- Document divergence with a comment explaining why HUGE workflow has different behavior (only if a genuine architectural reason exists)

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -q 'REVIEW_PASS_NUM.*-ge 2' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md → should NOT match (ratchet removed)
- grep -q 'MAX_ATTEMPTS.*deep' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md → should NOT match (upgrade removed)
- grep -q 'oscillation_no_arbiter_engagement' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md → SHOULD match (new signal)
- File is valid markdown

## Testing Mode
UPDATE — workflow file changes; test-exempt: documentation/skill-file modification

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (modify)
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW-HUGE.md (modify, if applicable)
